ядра.ядро_en: On the Gemini API model cards, supported data types by model: gemini-3-pro-image — inputs Image and Text, output Image and Text; gemini-3.1-flash-image and gemini-3.1-flash-lite-image — inputs Text, Image, Video and PDF, output Image and Text; gemini-2.5-flash-image — inputs Image and Text, output Image and Text.

ядра.ситуация_в_промпте: The author needs to know what can be fed to the model (text, images, PDF, video, audio) and what comes back (an image only or an image with text) — for example a reference in a PDF (a catalog, a brief) or in a video.

ядра.ядро_en: Gemini Image models can generate interleaved text-image output in a single turn — for example, a blog post with text and images, or an image for each step of a generated recipe — without separate requests; the model cards list interleaved images and text output as supported for Gemini 3 Pro Image, Gemini 3.1 Flash Image, Gemini 2.5 Flash Image and Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite Image. For interleaved output include both TEXT and IMAGE response modalities.

модели_различия.текст_en: Supported — external E-42-17 (part 1)

Supported in Capabilities (E-51-17); the Modalities row "Text — Input only" (E-51-4) is a single source anomaly (text output of Lite resolved in the dispute registry: Lite returns text alongside images)
Interleaved images and text output — Supported (card, E-261-13); outputs text and images (E-317-17)
outputs text and images (E-317-17); Firebase: text "interleaved or as part of image" (E-229-12)
Firebase: text "interleaved or as part of image" (E-229-12)
Gemini 2.0 Flash: a recipe with images in AI Studio (E-338-10); 2.0 preview: the prompt "Show me how to bake a macaron with images." (E-164-14)
Firebase: "Gemini Image models" (E-227-7, E-227-21); Agent Platform (E-282-14)

оговорки.текст_en: In Firebase AI Logic, text generation by the Gemini 3.x image models is marked "interleaved or as part of image" (text comes interleaved with images or as part of an image) instead of a plain yes.
Gemini 2.0 Flash image generation is native and conversational: images come from the same generate_content call as text (mixed response modalities) — extractor inference.

приёмы.текст_en: To assemble interleaved output, iterate over the response parts in order, writing text parts and saving each inline_data image, inserting a markdown image reference where the image occurs.
Ask explicitly for an image per unit of content (e.g. "For each scene, generate an image") and enable both Text and Image modalities (extractor inference from the 2.0 post).
To keep interleaved output in order, iterate over response parts, write text parts into a Markdown file, save each inline image as a PNG and insert a Markdown image link at the same position.

ядра.не_применяется_когда: A single image without text is needed (see the core on image-only output); a series of separate frames with control over each one — separate calls in a loop (see the core on one image per call); text output of Lite is disputed (see the core on the disputed text output of Nano Banana 2 Lite).

ядра.ядро_en: systemInstruction holds developer-set instructions that steer the model's behavior, acting like a preamble added before the model sees any further instructions from the end user; it is currently text only (only text should be used in its parts, each part as a separate paragraph, and its role field is ignored). The Agent Platform model cards list System instructions as supported for Gemini 3 Pro Image, Gemini 3.1 Flash Image, Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite Image and Gemini 2.5 Flash Image, while on the Gemini API a Cookbook notebook notes that the image model currently ignores system instructions, so they are passed as a message instead.

противоречия.решение: Разнесено по платформам (а, by platform): на Agent Platform карточки всех четырёх моделей отмечают System instructions — Supported (E-42-10, E-50-10, E-51-10, E-52-12); на Gemini API карточной строки нет, единственный источник — ноутбук Cookbook: модель «currently» игнорирует system instructions, их передают сообщением (E-22-25). «Поле поддерживается» и «модель его игнорирует» могут быть верны одновременно. Поведение на Gemini API — открытый межтемный спор С-34, закрывается живым замером.

ядра.примечание: Слито (см. коды_старые): Одно утверждение о systemInstruction у image-моделей: справочник/Cookbook/карточка Pro (ч1), карточки NB2/Lite/2.5 (ч2), справочник Agent Platform и карточка Pro (ч3). | [старое api-1-36] Дата источников E-22-25: исходная подпись «год копирайта (Copyright 2026)». | Параметр (ч1): имя=systemInstruction / system_instruction; путь=generateContent.systemInstruction | interactions.create(system_instruction="..."); значения=только текст (generateContent); string (Interactions); по_умолчанию=нет; платформа=Gemini API; Agent Platform (Pro: Supported); модели=pro (Agent Platform — Supported); дата=2026-09-22 / 2026-09-23; статус_формы=действует; для_завода=справочник: завод генерирует через посредника Higgsfield, поле напрямую не задаётся | [старое api-2-5] Внешние коды (вне учёта части): E-42-10; by platform: Supported on Agent Platform cards; on the Gemini API a notebook says the model currently ignores system instructions (С-34 open, closes by: живой замер); gemini-2.5-flash-image shuts down 2026-10-02 (Gemini API)

ядра.ядро_en: responseModalities lists the requested modalities of the response and is an exact match to the modalities of the response; an empty list is equivalent to requesting only text, and if the requested modalities do not match any supported combination an error is returned. It is required when using Gemini Image ("Nano Banana") models: to generate an image you must include IMAGE in the response modalities; to get both text and images, specify IMAGE and TEXT.

video-to-image: response_modalities ["image"] through generate_content (E-20-66)
book notebook (default lite): the text advises ["Image"], the code does not pass it (E-22-23)
the 2025 hackathon examples (2.5 preview) set no modalities and still get images (E-31-4, E-31-18)
the reference does not name models; the allowed combinations for image models are not listed
formula (E-78-4); Interactions API — IMAGE only (E-106-5)
formula (E-76-5); ADK agent — [TEXT, IMAGE] (E-124-2); codelab without a config (E-90-21)
formula (E-77-2); consistency notebook — IMAGE only (E-79-5)
"you must include IMAGE" (E-75-4); "make sure to set response_modalities=["TEXT", "IMAGE"]" (E-75-13); recipes — TEXT+IMAGE (E-74-2)
required (Firebase: all Gemini Image models — E-251-13, E-227-17)
required (E-251-13, E-227-17; Genkit: TEXT+IMAGE — E-199-4)
required (E-251-13); Android blog 2025-10-13: TEXT+IMAGE (E-243-20); the 2025-08-26 launch blogs called without a config (E-141-16, E-339-20) — superseded
Gemini 2.0 Flash: responseModalities must include "Image" (E-285-6); gemini-2.0-flash-preview-image-generation / gemini-2.0-flash-exp — ["TEXT","IMAGE"] / ["Text","Image"] (E-164-13, E-338-15)
Agent Platform: "You must include responseModalities: ["TEXT", "IMAGE"]" (E-319-2)
responseModalities: IMAGE / IMAGE only: IMAGE is required; IMAGE only — yes (Firebase, cookbook)

оговорки.текст_en: Spelling differs by surface: REST/JSONL "responseModalities": ["TEXT", "IMAGE"]; Python SDK config response_modalities=["TEXT","IMAGE"] / ["image"] / ["Image"]; OpenAI layer extra_body.generation_config {"responseModalities": ["IMAGE"]}.
To receive images, responseModalities must explicitly request a combination that includes IMAGE and is supported by the model.

Every image example on the Generate images page requests both TEXT and IMAGE response modalities (console "Image and text", SDK Modality.TEXT + Modality.IMAGE, REST ["TEXT", "IMAGE"]); the page never shows an image-only request.
The same generateContent request shape (text prompt + TEXT/IMAGE modalities, optional imageConfig) is used with both gemini-3.1-flash-image and gemini-2.5-flash-image across the language tabs.
response_modalities is chosen per task: ["IMAGE"] when only a picture is needed, ["TEXT", "IMAGE"] when interleaved steps or a caption are requested in the prompt.
The notebook's default editing config requests only image output via response_modalities=["IMAGE"]; passing no config is also valid and uses the model endpoint default config.
Agent Platform get-started page: "You must include responseModalities: ["TEXT", "IMAGE"] in your configuration" — whether TEXT is mandatory is disputed, see the core on image-only output.
In the image-config samples the TEXT modality is optional and IMAGE is required; include TEXT only if you want interleaved text and images.
Firebase migration from Imagen: as part of the model configuration set a response modality of IMAGE; all "after" samples on six platforms set IMAGE plus an ImageConfig aspect ratio.
Genkit Go: to get both a textual explanation and the edited image the call configures ResponseModalities TEXT and IMAGE.

приёмы.текст_en: Use response_modalities=['Image'] when you only want images (Cookbook book-illustration notebook).
Python: config=GenerateContentConfig(response_modalities=[Modality.TEXT, Modality.IMAGE]); the response parts contain either text or inline_data holding the image bytes.
REST: "generationConfig": { "responseModalities": ["TEXT", "IMAGE"], "imageConfig": { "aspectRatio": "16:9" } }
ADK tool: client.models.generate_content(model="gemini-3.1-flash-image", contents=prompt, config=types.GenerateContentConfig(response_modalities=["TEXT","IMAGE"]))
Edit: send the input image and the text instruction as parts of the same generate_content request, with response_modalities [TEXT, IMAGE]; the edited image comes back as inline_data.
Video-to-image: GenerateContentConfig(response_modalities=[Modality.TEXT, Modality.IMAGE]).
Recipes notebook: response_modalities=["TEXT", "IMAGE"] in the shared GenerateContentConfig.
Agent Platform samples request TEXT and IMAGE together and treat the response as an ordered list of text / inline-image parts.

ядра.ситуация_в_промпте: Any task whose output is an image (generation or editing) through generateContent or Firebase AI Logic: the call config must request the IMAGE modality, and the author decides whether to expect only an image or also text (caption, explanation, steps).
ядра.не_применяется_когда: Interactions API: response_modalities is deprecated/removed there and the modality is set by a response_format entry (see the cores on response_modalities removed from the Interactions API; the default text and image output and response_format arrays); Imagen (:predict / generateImages) has no modalities; calls through Higgsfield or the OpenAI-compatible images endpoint; the placement of the field in the REST body — see the core on the disputed placement of responseModalities in REST.

термины.значение_en: the list of response modalities (TEXT, IMAGE, AUDIO); an exact match to the response; empty = text only / a generationConfig field with the list of output types (TEXT, IMAGE, AUDIO); required for Nano Banana

ядра.ядро_en: On the Gemini API and in Firebase AI Logic you can configure the response modality so that the model generates only images or both images and text; TEXT is optional and should be included only if you want interleaved text and images (image-only output: response_modalities=["IMAGE"]); for Gemini 2.5 Flash Image the image-only response modality was added with the GA release on October 2, 2025. On Agent Platform image-only output is disputed: the get-started page says image-only output is not supported with these models and requires TEXT and IMAGE, while the Agent Platform release notes announce an image-only response modality for Gemini 2.5 Flash Image and Agent Platform notebooks request IMAGE only.

Firebase: IMAGE only or IMAGE+TEXT (E-227-9, E-227-38); Interactions cookbook: ["image"] (E-326-8)
image-only added with GA 2025-10-02 (E-152-2, E-341-2): response_modalities=["IMAGE"] (E-152-18, E-341-18); the Android blog of 2025-10-13 required TEXT+IMAGE (E-243-20) — superseded
Agent Platform get-started: "Image-only output is not supported with these models" (E-319-3), must include TEXT+IMAGE (E-319-2); all Agent Platform examples — TEXT+IMAGE (E-282-19)

оговорки.текст_en: You can add the "TEXT" modality for potential textual feedback (or in iterative chat mode); the notebook uses IMAGE only.
For images only IMAGE is requested and ImageContent is extracted (Interactions API codelab).
With GA, Gemini 2.5 Flash Image gained a wider range of aspect ratios and the ability to specify image-only output; the prose never names the parameter, the code shows response_modalities=["IMAGE"].
Image-only output is not supported with these models (Agent Platform get-started page; the models are not named).
Every code sample on the Agent Platform "Generate images" page requests TEXT and IMAGE together, never IMAGE alone (extractor inference).
Gemini Image models can be configured to return both images and text.

приёмы.текст_en: Interactions API: set response_modalities=["text","image"] to expect text and images; if you only want an image and don't need text, set response_modalities=["image"].

ядра.ситуация_в_промпте: The pipeline needs only the image file without accompanying text (which would otherwise be discarded) — or, conversely, text next to the image.
ядра.не_применяется_когда: Captions or steps are needed next to the image (see the core on the required IMAGE response modality); coherent text mixed with images is interleaving (see the core on interleaved text and image output); a Higgsfield call where modalities are not set.

ядра.ядро_en: In the Interactions API, the output format, aspect ratio and image size can optionally be configured with response_format: image output settings are specified in a response_format entry with "type": "image" (image_config was removed from generation_config); ImageResponseFormat fields are aspect_ratio, image_size, mime_type and delivery, and type is the only required field. Example: {"type": "image", "aspect_ratio": "16:9", "image_size": "1K", "mime_type": "image/jpeg"}.

модели_различия.текст_en: Gemini 3 guide examples: 16:9 + 4K + google_search on gemini-3-pro-image-preview (E-6-20)
all examples of the generation page (E-1-33, E-1-55, E-1-167)
the reference and the specification do not name models; the migration example uses gemini-3.8-flash (E-27-12)

оговорки.текст_en: New-schema opt-in for REST was the header Api-Revision: 2026-05-20; the new schema became the default after May 26, 2026 and the legacy schema was removed on June 8, 2026 (see the core on the Interactions schema migration timeline).

Image output options can be (re)set on a follow-up turn: in the multi-turn example the second turn sets mime_type "image/jpeg", aspect_ratio "16:9" and image_size "2K" although the first turn did not.
Java/Go SDKs express the same values as enums (ImageResponseFormatAspectRatio…, ImageResponseFormatImageSize.FOUR_K).

Output format controls live in response_format while model-behaviour settings (thinking_level, thinking_summaries, seed) stay in generation_config, so an image request uses two separate configuration blocks.
The Interactions reference shows no image_config or response_modalities field in generation_config; response_format is the only place for image output parameters.

приёмы.текст_en: Multiple reference images plus a response_format image entry in one call: five image parts after the text part with aspect_ratio "5:4" and image_size "2K".
To get higher-resolution assets, specify image_size in the response_format.

ядра.ядро_en: In generateContent, generationConfig.imageConfig is the optional config for image generation; an error is returned if this field is set for models that do not support these config options. Not all GenerationConfig parameters are configurable for every model.

The same page exposes a second, parallel way — generationConfig.responseFormat.image — and does not say which takes precedence or whether both may be set together.

ядра.ядро_en: Temperature controls the degree of randomness in token selection; for the Gemini image models (and for Gemini 3 models up to 3.5 Flash) it ranges from 0.0 to 2.0 with a default of 1.0, and a temperature of 0 means that the highest probability tokens are always selected (responses are mostly deterministic, but a small amount of variation is still possible).

оговорки.текст_en: Temperature controls the degree of randomness in token selection. Lower temperatures are good for prompts that require a less open-ended or creative response, while higher temperatures can lead to more diverse or creative results.
A temperature of 0 means that the highest probability tokens are always selected; responses for a given prompt are mostly deterministic, but a small amount of variation is still possible.
1.0 is the recommended starting value for temperature.
Nano Banana recipes notebook: temperature=1, top_p=0.95, max_output_tokens=32768, response_modalities ["TEXT","IMAGE"] for gemini-2.5-flash-image-preview (author's values, no rationale).
Lower temperatures suit more deterministic, less open-ended responses, higher temperatures can give more diverse or creative results — described for text; the effect on images is not described.

приёмы.текст_en: If the model returns a response that's too generic, too short, or the model gives a fallback response, try increasing the temperature; if the model enters infinite generation, increasing the temperature to at least 0.1 may help.
Recipes notebook: generation config temperature=1, top_p=0.95, max_output_tokens=32768, response_modalities ["TEXT", "IMAGE"].
For more deterministic restoration outputs: temperature 0.0 (with top_p 0.0, seed 42).

ядра.ситуация_в_промпте: The call sets or plans a temperature: decide whether repeated generations from one prompt should be varied or as repeatable as possible, and know the allowed range and the default.
ядра.не_применяется_когда: A Higgsfield call where temperature is not set; Imagen (:predict) has no temperature parameter; the newest general-use Gemini 3.x models ignore temperature (see the core on sampling parameters ignored by the newest Gemini 3.x models); for Gemini 3 models Google recommends keeping 1.0 (see the core on keeping temperature at 1.0 for Gemini 3).

ядра.ядро_en: For all Gemini 3 models, Google strongly recommends keeping the temperature parameter at its default value of 1.0; changing it (setting it below 1.0) may lead to unexpected behavior such as looping or degraded performance, particularly in complex mathematical or reasoning tasks; when migrating, remove explicit temperature settings and use the Gemini 3 default. As of July 21, 2026 the Gemini API changelog lists the sampling parameters temperature, top_p and top_k as deprecated; the Agent Platform card for Gemini 3 Pro Image gives Temperature 0.0-2.0 (default 1.0) and topP 0.0-1.0 (default 0.95).

ядра.подтема: topP и topK: смысл, порядок отбора токенов, диапазон topP
ядра.ядро_en: topP (nucleus sampling) selects tokens from most to least probable until the sum of their probabilities equals the topP value; for the Gemini image models topP ranges from 0.0 to 1.0 with a default of 0.95. topK makes the model consider only the k most probable next tokens: for each token selection step the top-K tokens with the highest probabilities are sampled, then tokens are further filtered based on top-P, with the final token selected using temperature sampling.

оговорки.текст_en: Tokens are selected from most probable to the least until the sum of their probabilities equals the value of top-P. For the least variable results, set top-P to 0.
topK is described for text: it can give more coherent and less random text.

A top-K of 1 means the next selected token is the most probable among all tokens in the model's vocabulary (also called greedy decoding), while a top-K of 3 means that the next token is selected from among the three most probable tokens by using temperature. (not supported for Gemini 1.5)

приёмы.текст_en: Recipes notebook uses top_p=0.95.
Restoration config uses top_p 0.0 for low randomness.

ядра.ситуация_в_промпте: The call tunes topP/topK sampling to trade variants against repeatability or to reduce the spread of results between runs.

ядра.ядро_en: Media is supplied in a part either as inline raw bytes (base64 data) or as data stored in a file (a URI). With inline raw bytes the part must have a fixed IANA MIME type (inline_data/inlineData {mime_type, data}); for a file by URI (FileData/fileData, fileUri required) Agent Platform requires the mimeType as well, while in the Gemini API reference FileData.mimeType is optional. In the Interactions API an image part is {"type": "image", "data": <base64>, "mime_type": "image/png"} (ImageContent: data or uri, mime_type, resolution).

fileData: fileUri + mimeType (mimeType required on Agent Platform, optional in the Gemini API reference)

ядра.подтема: SDK: как положить картинки/видео в contents
ядра.ядро_en: In the Gen AI SDK, local image data is included in the request contents with Part.from_bytes, images or videos stored in Cloud Storage (or a YouTube URL) with Part.from_uri(file_uri, mime_type), and for multiple reference images you provide multiple Part.from_uri instances, one for each reference image.

модели_различия.текст_en: other models (Imagen, text Gemini models): per the codes

оговорки.текст_en: Start a chat to continuously edit images by talking with Gemini; use Part.from_uri for reference images stored in Cloud Storage.
One request can mix an image referenced from Cloud Storage (Part.from_uri) with an image read from a local file and sent as bytes (Part.from_bytes).
An image in Cloud Storage is passed as Part.from_uri(file_uri=..., mime_type=...) inside contents of client.models.generate_content, alongside the text prompt.
To edit an existing image with Nano Banana, pass the text prompt and the image (e.g. a PIL Image) together in the contents list of generate_content.
Other SDK tabs: Java Part.fromBytes(..., "image/png") + Part.fromText; Node.js inlineData base64 + text; Go InlineData image/png.
Genkit dotprompt: the {{ media }} template injects the photo into the user prompt, sending a multimodal (text + image) prompt.

ядра.ситуация_в_промпте: References must be fed into the call: one local file, several cloud files, a video by a link, or a mix of all these in one request.
ядра.не_применяется_когда: REST without an SDK (see the core on inline and file media parts); Imagen customization (see the core on Imagen customization references).

ядра.ядро_en: You can set media_resolution in generationConfig to apply low, medium, or high resolution to all media in the request (Python SDK: GenerateContentConfig(media_resolution=types.MediaResolution.MEDIA_RESOLUTION_LOW)), or set resolution for individual media parts (types.PartMediaResolution(level=types.PartMediaResolutionLevel.MEDIA_RESOLUTION_HIGH) on a Part), which overrides the top-level setting; the ultra_high media resolution can only be set for individual media parts.

оговорки.текст_en: If unspecified, the model uses optimal defaults based on the media type.
You can specify a media resolution for image and PDF inputs, which affects how images are tokenized and how many tokens are used for each image.
The image tokenization feature (media resolution) is in Preview, subject to the Pre-GA Offerings Terms; Pre-GA features are available "as is" and might have limited support.

mediaResolution controls the tradeoff between the quality of the media and the number of tokens used to represent it; a higher resolution lets the model perceive more detail but uses more tokens; it doesn't affect the image dimensions sent to the model.

приёмы.текст_en: Per part (SDK): types.Part(..., media_resolution=types.PartMediaResolution(level=types.PartMediaResolutionLevel.MEDIA_RESOLUTION_HIGH)).
Globally (SDK): GenerateContentConfig(media_resolution=types.MediaResolution.MEDIA_RESOLUTION_LOW).
Keep a low global mediaResolution and raise it only on the Part that needs detail, since Part-level settings override global ones.

ядра.ситуация_в_промпте: References or source images go into the call, and it matters how much detail the model sees in them (small text, a face, a logo) versus input token spend; one input image may need detail while the others do not.
ядра.не_применяется_когда: The resolution of the OUTPUT image is image_size (see the core on image_size values); media_resolution affects only the input; applicability to image models is not confirmed by the pages.

ядра.ядро_en: Nano Banana returns content parts containing image data instead of a specific image response object: the response is a list of parts, where text parts carry text and the generated image comes back as inline_data (inlineData, base64 image bytes) in a separate part; iterate over response.candidates[0].content.parts (or response.parts), print the text parts and decode and save the inline_data parts as images (e.g. part.as_image().save(...)).

оговорки.текст_en: In batch results images come back as inline_data / inlineData parts (mime type + base64) alongside text parts; Python: part.as_image().save(...).
When parsing an image-model response, the notebook displays any text parts and takes the first image part, expecting a single output image.
The ADK generate_image tool takes the first inline_data part as the image bytes and saves it as a PNG artifact.
The model response returns the image data as a data URI in the format data:<mime type>;base64,<base64 encoded image>, which must be decoded (split mime type and base64 part) before saving the file.
Python SDK: open the bytes with PIL — Image.open(BytesIO(part.inline_data.data)).
Newer Python SDK pattern: iterate response.parts, check part.inline_data is not None, convert with part.as_image().
JavaScript: response.response.candidates[0].content.parts; part.text or part.inlineData with base64 data → Buffer.from(..., "base64") → PNG.
Firebase Web: the generated image is returned as inline data with a mimeType and base64 data.
Firebase Kotlin: take the first candidate's content parts and filter for an ImagePart (firstOrNull — the image may be absent).
Firebase samples read the image from the first inline data part and explicitly handle a response with no image data.
Clients should expect mixed output — text parts (often a description of the image) interleaved with inline image parts, possibly several — and iterate over all parts (extractor inference).

приёмы.текст_en: For interleaved output keep the order: write text parts to Markdown, save each inline image as PNG and insert a Markdown image link at the same position.

ядра.подтема: Interactions API: запрос IMAGE и разбор шагов
ядра.ядро_en: In the Gemini Interactions API, text, audio, or image content generated by the model is returned in a ModelOutputStep; by requesting the IMAGE modality you can generate infographics, diagrams, or sketchnotes based on text input, and the image bytes are extracted by filtering the ModelOutputStep content for Content.ImageContent (returned as raw bytes).

оговорки.текст_en: The codelab uses a custom Java SDK for the Gemini Interactions API (Maven artifact io.github.glaforge:gemini-interactions-api-sdk, version 0.10.1), not the Google Gen AI SDK.
The sketchnote example calls the model ID "gemini-3-pro-image-preview".

приёмы.текст_en: Because models can perform reasoning, a ThoughtStep might appear first. It is best practice to filter the steps to locate the ModelOutputStep containing the generated content.
For images only IMAGE is requested (responseModalities(Interaction.Modality.IMAGE)) and ImageContent is extracted; data can be saved directly as a .png file.

ядра.ситуация_в_промпте: The call goes through the Interactions API (an agentic interface with steps), not through generateContent.
ядра.не_применяется_когда: A call through generateContent / the Gen AI SDK (see the cores on the required IMAGE response modality; reading the generateContent response parts).

ядра.ядро_en: safetySettings adjust the likelihood of getting responses that may be considered harmful: safetySettings[] is a list of unique SafetySetting instances (no more than one per category) enforced on both the request contents and the response candidates, overriding the defaults for the categories it names; you can configure blocking thresholds for each harm category (such as sexual, hate, harassment and dangerous content) based on the probability and/or severity of the harmful content. HarmBlockThreshold values: BLOCK_LOW_AND_ABOVE (only NEGLIGIBLE allowed), BLOCK_MEDIUM_AND_ABOVE (NEGLIGIBLE and LOW), BLOCK_ONLY_HIGH (NEGLIGIBLE, LOW and MEDIUM), BLOCK_NONE (all content allowed), OFF (turn off the safety filter); the Agent Platform image samples set method PROBABILITY, category HARM_CATEGORY_DANGEROUS_CONTENT and threshold BLOCK_MEDIUM_AND_ABOVE.

The API blocks any contents and responses that fail to meet the thresholds set by these settings; if there is no SafetySetting for a given category in the list, the API uses the default safety setting for that category.

оговорки.текст_en: A model refusal is returned as a text response with FinishReason STOP, while filter blocks surface as BlockedReason or IMAGE_SAFETY-type finish reasons; so STOP alone does not mean an image was produced, and a pipeline should check whether an image part is actually present.
If a response has no candidates, the reason can be read from response.prompt_feedback.block_reason and block_reason_message.
When generation is blocked, the candidate's finish_reason is not STOP and a finish_message is available.
The model usually gives a text response saying it can't generate unsafe images.
In Firebase AI Logic a generateContent call to a Gemini Image model can fail because the prompt or candidate was blocked; the Web sample catches this as an error ("Prompt or candidate was blocked").

приёмы.текст_en: Check the candidate's finish_reason; if it is not STOP, the image was not generated and the reason should be surfaced as a prompt content error.
STOP alone does not mean an image was produced — check whether an image part is present; the only stated signal of refusal is the response text (extractor inference).

ядра.ситуация_в_промпте: The call returned 'successfully' but there is no image, or it returned empty — determine who refused: the input filter (prompt blocked), the output filter (FinishReason IMAGE_SAFETY) or the model itself (a refusal text with FinishReason STOP).
ядра.не_применяется_когда: Quota or overload errors (429) — see the core on retries on 429 and 400; support codes in raiFilteredReason — see the core on the raiFilteredReason support codes; a generation that simply did not trigger (NO_IMAGE) — see the core on responses without an image, NO_IMAGE.

ядра.ядро_en: Prompt-level promptFeedback.blockReason IMAGE_SAFETY: candidates blocked due to unsafe image generation content. Candidate-level FinishReason: IMAGE_SAFETY (generated images contain safety violations), IMAGE_PROHIBITED_CONTENT (generated images have other prohibited content), IMAGE_RECITATION (stopped due to recitation), IMAGE_OTHER (other miscellaneous issue), NO_IMAGE (the model was expected to generate an image, but none was generated). The API returns either all requested candidates or none; no candidates at all only if something was wrong with the prompt.

оговорки.текст_en: Other prompt block reasons: SAFETY, OTHER, BLOCKLIST, PROHIBITED_CONTENT; if blockReason is set, rephrase the prompt (E-19-7, outside this input).

приёмы.текст_en: A client should check both levels (promptFeedback.blockReason and each candidate's finishReason), since an empty or image-less response has a distinct code for each cause.

ядра.ситуация_в_промпте: No image arrived or an empty response came back — use the code to understand the cause (a filter, a prohibition, "recitation", or the model simply did not draw).
ядра.не_применяется_когда: Quota or HTTP errors (see the core on HTTP 429).

ядра.подтема: коды поддержки фильтров (raiFilteredReason) и их категории
ядра.ядро_en: Depending on the safety filters you configure, your output may contain a safety reason code in raiFilteredReason (an error message followed by "Support codes:" and a numeric code); each listed support code corresponds to a specific harmful category and to where content was filtered (prompt input or image output).

части.текст_en: Child — input 58061214 / output 17301594 (child content that isn't allowed due to the API request settings or allowlisting)
Celebrity — input 29310472 / output 15236754 (photorealistic representation of a celebrity)
People/Face — 39322892, output (person or face when it isn't allowed due to the request safety settings)
Personal information — 92201652, input (PII in the text, such as credit card numbers, home addresses)
Celebrity or child — 64151117, input and output (photorealistic representation of a celebrity or child that violates Google's safety policies)

модели_различия.текст_en: the Agent Platform responsible AI page (E-292-14..16)
Agent Platform, Gemini image generation (E-292-16..29)

оговорки.текст_en: Several filters are conditional on request configuration: safety codes depend on the filters you configure, child content is blocked when not allowed by API request settings or allowlisting, and people/faces are blocked when not allowed by request safety settings; the page does not name these settings.
The example support code 56562880 in the raiFilteredReason sample is the Violence image-output code from the mapping table.
Child: detects child content that isn't allowed due to the API request settings or allowlisting.
People/Face: detects a person or face when it isn't allowed due to the request safety settings (image output only).
Celebrity: detects a photorealistic representation of a celebrity in the request.
Celebrity or child: detects photorealistic representation of a celebrity or child that violates Google's safety policies; it overlaps the separate Child and Celebrity categories without explanation.
Input-only categories: Dangerous content, Personal information (PII such as credit card numbers or home addresses), Toxic, Vulgar; Violence looks at the image or text.

ядра.ситуация_в_промпте: The call returned a support code instead of an image (raiFilteredReason with a numeric code) — use the code to understand which category in the prompt or in the result triggered the filter, and rewrite the task.
ядра.не_применяется_когда: A refusal by the model itself as text with STOP (see the cores on the three refusal paths; the three refusal paths).

ядра.подтема: миграция Imagen → Nano Banana (Gen AI SDK, Firebase AI Logic)
ядра.ядро_en: To migrate text-to-image generation from Imagen to a Gemini Image model: use an appropriate Gemini Image model name (gemini-2.5-flash-image, or Nano Banana 2 models such as gemini-3.1-flash-image) instead of Imagen model names; call generateContent (client.models.generate_content) with the text prompt instead of generateImages (client.models.generate_images); in Firebase AI Logic create a GenerativeModel instance instead of an ImagenModel instance and migrate ImagenGenerationConfig to a GenerationConfig with a response modality of IMAGE (optionally with a nested ImageConfig) and ImagenSafetySettings to SafetySetting. Nano Banana returns content parts containing image data instead of a specific image response object.

части.текст_en: GenerationConfig with response modality IMAGE (+ optional nested ImageConfig) instead of ImagenGenerationConfig
response: parts with image data instead of an image object

gemini-2.5-flash-image
Imagen — the source model
named as the replacement (E-228-10)
Imagen — the starting point (E-228-18)

only the caveat on aspectRatio in an ImageConfig instead of Imagen aspectRatio covers gemini-3-pro-image (E-228-25); Pro is not named as a migration target

оговорки.текст_en: The page gives no mapping for Imagen-specific request settings (number of images, aspect ratio, other generate_images config).
All "after" samples on six platforms set IMAGE and an explicit 4:3 aspect ratio through ImageConfig and leave the prompt text unchanged (extractor inference).
For Imagen (legacy), if fewer images were generated than requested, the response filteredReason describes why they were filtered out.
Instead of Imagen aspectRatio, use aspectRatio in an ImageConfig.

gemini-2.5-flash-image, named here as a migration target, is itself being shut down: in Firebase AI Logic Gemini 2.5 models shut down in October 2026 (E-227-2); on Agent Platform it is deprecated with retirement on March 15, 2027 (E-52-2); the Gemini API deprecations page gives an earliest shutdown date of October 2, 2026 (E-18-10).

приёмы.текст_en: Check whether the response finishReason is NO_IMAGE and handle the case where no images were generated.

примеры.что_показывает_en: The text prompt variable passed to generateContent after migrating from Imagen (the sample keeps the prompt unchanged).

ядра.не_применяется_когда: Code written for Gemini Image from the start — see the cores on the required IMAGE response modality; aspect ratio in generateContent; ImageConfig in Firebase AI Logic are enough.

ядра.ядро_en: Imagen is called via REST with POST https://REGION-aiplatform.googleapis.com/v1/projects/PROJECT_ID/locations/REGION/publishers/google/models/MODEL_VERSION:predict and body {"instances": [{"prompt": "TEXT_PROMPT"}], "parameters": {"sampleCount": IMAGE_COUNT}} (optionally "sampleImageSize": "IMAGE_RESOLUTION"); the request returns image objects as base64-encoded images in predictions, each with mimeType image/png and bytesBase64Encoded.

оговорки.текст_en: TEXT_PROMPT: The text prompt that guides what images the model generates. This field is required for both generation and editing.

Quickstart REST uses the :predict method with instances [{"prompt": "a cat reading a book"}] and parameters {"sampleCount": 1} on imagen-4.0-generate-preview-05-20 (region us-central1), and returns base64 image bytes.
Imagen customization: the response returns one prediction object per sample with base64-encoded image bytes and mimeType image/png.
storageUri (optional) sets a Cloud Storage bucket for output images; if not provided, base64-encoded image bytes are returned in the response.
If you use a model that supports prompt enhancement, the response includes an additional prompt field with the enhanced prompt used for generation.

For imagegeneration@006 the digital watermark is enabled by default; the seed field can't be used while digital watermark is enabled.

ядра.подтема: Imagen customization: referenceId и типы рефов
ядра.ядро_en: Reference images of the same subject share the same referenceId (the ID of the reference image, or of a series of reference images that correspond to the same subject or style), while a control face mesh image has a distinct referenceId; referenceImages use referenceType REFERENCE_TYPE_SUBJECT (subjectImageConfig with subjectType SUBJECT_TYPE_PERSON or SUBJECT_TYPE_PRODUCT) and REFERENCE_TYPE_CONTROL (controlImageConfig with controlType CONTROL_TYPE_FACE_MESH, enableControlImageComputation true).

модели_различия.текст_en: other models (Imagen, text Gemini models): per the codes

оговорки.текст_en: You can send a person customization request with or without a face mesh control image; if you omit the control reference object ("referenceType": "REFERENCE_TYPE_CONTROL"), Imagen will automatically detect a face mesh control area.
In REST requests, each reference image must be specified as a base64-encoded byte string.

The Python sample calls client.models.edit_image on imagen-3.0-capability-001 with EditImageConfig(edit_mode="EDIT_MODE_DEFAULT", number_of_images=1, safety_filter_level="BLOCK_MEDIUM_AND_ABOVE", person_generation="ALLOW_ADULT").

ядра.ситуация_в_промпте: Several photos of one person or product must be submitted as one subject, separately from a service reference (a face mask).
ядра.не_применяется_когда: Gemini image models — references are passed as contents parts and numbered in the text (see the cores on putting images and videos into contents with the SDK; placing a single image before the text).

ядра.ядро_en: Image models are used as a tool behind an agent: in the Agent Factory demo an ADK slide-generator agent calls Nano Banana Pro via a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, stores the generated images in a Cloud Storage bucket and presents the links; in the ADK lab a generate_image tool calls gemini-3.1-flash-image with the text prompt and response_modalities ["TEXT", "IMAGE"] and saves the first inline_data part as a PNG artifact.

модели_различия.текст_en: Agent Factory: ADK + Antigravity + MCP (E-69-4, E-69-5)
Cityscape — an ADK demo with Google-managed MCP servers (E-110-8)

оговорки.текст_en: Across the page Nano Banana Pro is used only as a tool behind an agent; no image prompts, prompt structure or generation parameters are shown.
Cityscape is a demo agent built with Google's ADK that turns a simple text prompt into a unique AI-generated city image.

вопросы.чем_снят: правка: Л7 — справочные ядра API без магнита; магнит остался у двух ядер слоя промпт (Я-api-175, Я-api-180)

вопросы.текст: [проверка] Ранг страницы 282 (cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/…/multimodal-response-generation — документация Google Cloud, официальность подтверждена) во всех темах стоит 4 вместо 1. вопросы.текст: [проверка] Трактовка платформ: сшивка решает расхождения Gemini API против Agent Platform по (ж) (Я-api-47, 48, 59, 88, 94), хотя (ж) — продукт против API. вопросы.чем_снят: правка: Л3 — Я-api-168–175 действует: false (П-52…П-59)

вопросы.текст: [проверка] Значения моделей: «да» ставится и для отрицательных утверждений, «нет» использовано один раз на 1098 ячеек (Я-api-54). Лучший источник: ранг → дата (разница ≤ 2 дней не считается) → порядок в списке формулирующих; выводы экстрактора (как_получено = «выведено…») в выборе не участвуют и стоят только в оговорках, приёмах и версиях противоречий с пометкой «вывод экстрактора». Статуса «выведено» нет: ни одно ядро не построено на одних выводах.
